name: net_prologue_mansion_axel_form_sora_host
description: FM-02 rehearsal route (the committed Computer Room -> Basement Hall pilot, both Dusk waves) into Axel II, 02/14 btl137 (checked site tt20-137). A default Roxas seat builds the native encounter body 0x323 (P_EX110_BTLF) for its local and for its clone on the other seat, with both keyblades; a Sora seat keeps Sora for both. Inside the host's combat-admission hold (proven around the window, else a setup failure), one synthetic 1-HP native hit lands on each seat's clone: the observer's own HP, every SAVE character record (SAVE+0x24F0, 0xE04) and every drive-form row (SAVE+0x32F4, 0x230: the row a dual-wield status +0x254 references) must be byte-identical just before and just after the hits. Right after the admission release each owner is downed once and revived by the other seat (owner_downs: an Axel downing counts, else the DownedSpike fixture Kill; both seats down is a harness failure). Each owner then moves, jumps and attacks alone, filmed on both seats; then both are downed and the host takes the native Continue to the Computer Room 02/15 d99, where each seat holds only its selected body: no dual-wield body, keyblade pair or old clone. Video-only paired clips (lead amendment). Rehearsal save, no save. Selections: host 0x54, friend 0x5A.
